scriptData.label: @effect.name
Torn Leg Muscle (Major)

description.label: Description
description.value:
The arrow slams into your hip near the groin. Cleaving through multiple smaller blood vessels it finally hits the jackpot in the shape of the external iliac artery! Massive loss of blood ensues!

Effects: Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (3), which requires Surgery to remove. Should you survive you’ll have a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.3S4OYOZLauXctmev]{Torn Muscle (Major)}.

Surgery (Very Hard) is required for Extraction.
